channel.title: MARGIN — An Independent Editorial Publication
channel.description: Critical inquiries into software, interfaces, cultural artifacts, and considered living.

item.title: What We Lose When Every Interface Looks the Same
item.author: editors@margin-journal.org (Elena Rostova)
item.description: As design systems and standardized component libraries consolidate our visual habits, we have traded the serendipity of peculiar digital places for an unvarying, frictionless beige.

item.title: The Quiet Return of the Personal Website
item.author: editors@margin-journal.org (Julian Thorne)
item.description: Faced with algorithmic fatigue and platform decay, creators are quietly rediscovering the radical sovereignty of owning an independent domain.

item.title: Why Good Software Often Feels Invisible
item.author: editors@margin-journal.org (Marcus Vance)
item.description: The best tools do not demand reverence; they step aside so the human craft can flourish.

item.title: Notes on Attention in a Distracted World
item.author: editors@margin-journal.org (Dr. Sarah Lin)
item.description: Simone Weil, cognitive ecology, and the discipline of looking deeply. Why attention is the purest form of generosity.
